Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent hallucinated specific biographical details not present in the source material. The provided screenshot and metadata from the Wikipedia page for Michael Imeretinsky only showed the introductory section (birth, parents, lineage) and a fundraising banner; it did not contain the text stating he "graduated from Lancing College." The agent incorrectly inferred or invented this fact to fulfill the task, rather than reporting that the visible portion of the page did not contain the graduation information or that the search results were inconclusive regarding the specific graduation institution. This led to a false conclusion in the final answer.
